shorts.title: Is the Bermuda Triangle Real? 🔍 Meatball Investigates
shorts.description:
Five Navy bombers flew out to sea, and vanished. Even the rescue plane sent after Flight 19 was lost, most likely in an explosion. The 'Bermuda Triangle' name comes from a 1964 magazine story by Vincent Gaddis.

#shorts #meatballinvestigates #weirdhistory #mystery #meatballmyths

shorts.title: Operation Northwoods: The Conspiracy That Was TRUE 🔍
shorts.description:
A US general signed a plan to blow up an American ship. One idea in the plan: fake the shoot-down of a civilian airliner with a remote-controlled drone. The memo was declassified in 1997.

#shorts #meatballinvestigates #weirdhistory #mystery #meatballmyths

shorts.title: What REALLY Crashed at Roswell? 🔍 Meatball Investigates
shorts.description:
A rancher found shiny wreckage all over his field. Project Mogul's balloons carried microphones to listen for Soviet nuclear tests. The Air Force's reports came out in 1994-1997.

#shorts #meatballinvestigates #weirdhistory #mystery #meatballmyths

shorts.title: The US Planned to Nuke the Moon. It's REAL 🌕 Meatball Investigates
shorts.description:
A Chicago physicist worked out how to nuke the Moon. The study, 'A Study of Lunar Research Flights' (AFSWC-TR-59-39, 1959), stayed secret for about 40 years. Carl Sagan worked out how the dust cloud would spread.

#shorts #meatballinvestigates #weirdhistory #mystery #meatballmyths

shorts.title: The Dancing Plague of 1518 Was REAL 🔍
shorts.description:
A woman danced in the street for days, nonstop. It happened in Strasbourg in July 1518. The physician Paracelsus wrote about it a few years later.

#shorts #meatballinvestigates #weirdhistory #mystery #meatballmyths

shorts.title: Lightning Never Strikes Twice? WRONG 🔍
shorts.description:
Lightning hit the Empire State Building. Again. And again. Park ranger Roy Sullivan holds the record: struck by lightning 7 times between 1942 and 1977, and survived all of them.

#shorts #meatballinvestigates #weirdhistory #mystery #meatballmyths
